_why: PokéAPI's dataset has no effect text and no flavour text for any item introduced in generation 9 — the entries exist, the words are simply absent. That is most of what a modern VGC team holds, so these are written by hand and merged over the generated file by scripts/build-effects.mjs. Every line here describes a published game mechanic; nothing is inferred. Delete an entry as soon as PokéAPI publishes one, rather than keeping two sources of truth. `npm run build:effects` prints what is still uncovered.
_voice: No line here opens with "Held:". These are only ever shown under the name of an item already in a Pokémon's hand, so the preamble says nothing the page hasn't. build-effects.mjs strips the same prefix off the 279 upstream entries that carry it, which is what keeps these two sources reading as one.
_scope: Battle-relevant held items only. Evolution items (Metal Alloy, Syrupy Apple, the teacups, Black Augurite, Peat Block, Malicious Armor) are left out: they are never held to a table, so a popover on one would be noise. The generation-9 Mega Stones are left out too — the card already prints a MEGA badge next to the Pokémon, which says the same thing in the place it matters.

ability-shield.text: The holder's Ability cannot be changed, suppressed, swapped or ignored.

booster-energy.text: Activates Protosynthesis or Quark Drive as though harsh sunlight or Electric Terrain were up, raising the holder's highest stat. Consumed on use.

clear-amulet.text: The holder's stats cannot be lowered by other Pokémon.

covert-cloak.text: The holder is shielded from the additional effects of attacks.

fairy-feather.text: Fairy-type moves from the holder do 20% more damage.

loaded-dice.text: Moves that strike two to five times always hit at least four. Population Bomb hits at least four times.

mirror-herb.text: When an opposing Pokémon's stats rise, the holder copies the boost. Consumed on use.

punching-glove.text: Punching moves do 10% more damage and no longer make contact.

cornerstone-mask.text: Ogerpon takes its Cornerstone Mask form, Grass/Rock, and its moves do 20% more damage.

hearthflame-mask.text: Ogerpon takes its Hearthflame Mask form, Grass/Fire, and its moves do 20% more damage.

wellspring-mask.text: Ogerpon takes its Wellspring Mask form, Grass/Water, and its moves do 20% more damage.
